questions.stem_text: What factors affect the rate of transpiration?

options.B: Plant species, root depth, and wind speed
options.C: Soil fertility, irrigation methods, and cloud cover
options.D: Water salinity, leaf color, and time of day
options.E: Leaf surface area, stem length, and moon phase

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Temperature, humidity, and air currents

questions.stem_text: What are the different types of point mutations?

options.A: Frame shift mutations and nucleotide repeats
options.B: Base substitutions and small insertions and deletions
options.E: Duplication mutations and triplet repeat expansions

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Base substitutions and small insertions and deletions

questions.stem_text: Which is a true statement concerning genetic variation?

options.A: It is created by the direct action of natural selection.
options.B: It tends to be reduced by the processes involved when diploid organisms produce gametes.
options.C: It must be present in a population before natural selection can act upon the population.
options.D: It is always increased by the processes involved when diploid organisms produce gametes.
options.E: It is not affected by the environmental changes.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - It must be present in a population before natural selection can act upon the population.

questions.stem_text:
Which group is composed entirely of individuals who maintained that species are fixed
(i.e., unchanging)?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Aristotle, Linnaeus, and Cuvier

questions.stem_text: Compare the methods of obtaining oxygen in the earthworm, the frog, the fish and man.

options.A: Earthworms use gills, frogs use both gills and lungs, fish use lungs, and humans use skin.
options.B: Earthworms and humans use lungs, frogs and fish use gills.
options.C: All use gills for obtaining oxygen.
options.D: Earthworms and humans use gills, frogs use skin, and fish use lungs.
options.E: Earthworms use lungs, frogs use gills, fish use skin, and humans use gills.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Earthworms use gills, frogs use both gills and lungs, fish use lungs, and humans use skin.

questions.stem_text: Can increases in the cigarette tax rate be linked to cigarette retail prices?
questions.answer_explanation: Numerous studies have found that taxation is one of the most effective policy instruments for tobacco control. However, these findings come from countries that have market economies where market forces determine prices and influence how cigarette taxes are passed to the consumers in retail prices. China's tobacco industry is not a market economy; therefore, non-market forces and the current Chinese tobacco monopoly system determine cigarette prices. The result is that tax increases do not necessarily get passed on to the retail price.

questions.stem_text: Are head and neck specific quality of life measures necessary?
questions.answer_explanation: Head and neck-specific QOL measures are necessary and should include domains that reflect ES, SC, and AP.

questions.stem_text: Did Chile's traffic law reform push police enforcement?
questions.answer_explanation: Findings suggest that traffic law reforms in order to have an effect on both traffic fatality and injury rates reduction require changes in police enforcement practices. Last, this case also illustrates how the diffusion of successful road safety practices globally promoted by WHO and World Bank can be an important influence for enhancing national road safety practices.

questions.stem_text: Is there a correlation between androgens and sexual desire in women?
questions.answer_explanation: In the present study, FT and androstenedione were statistically significantly correlated with sexual desire in the total cohort of women. ADT-G did not correlate more strongly than circulating androgens with sexual desire and is therefore not superior to measuring circulating androgens by mass spectrometry.
